en: Brother, come not home. Our mother walked up from the cellar last night. We buried her at harvest.
zh: 哥哥，別回家。昨晚母親從地窖走上來了。我們是在秋收時埋葬她的。

en: Seven cellars barred this week. The Order's rider saith one more guardian is sent. He would not say when the last came back.
zh: 這週封了七個地窖。騎士團的信使說，又派了一位守門人來。他不肯說上一位什麼時候回來過。

en: Came for the gold they speak of. Found only stairs. The stairs are longer than they were yesterday.
zh: 為了傳說中的黃金而來，只找到樓梯。這些樓梯比昨天更長了。

en: Count the steps going down. Count them again coming up. They will not match.
zh: 下樓時數一次階梯，上樓時再數一次。兩個數字不會一樣。

en: Here lie the Sixth Watch, who were told to stay. They stayed.
zh: 這裡躺著第六守衛隊。他們奉命留下，他們留下了。

en: Day nine thousand, or thereabouts. No relief. The captain saith the order standeth until it be lifted. None remaineth who can lift it.
zh: 大約第九千天，沒有人來換班。隊長說命令解除前都算數。可是能解除命令的人，已經都不在了。

en: By the Order: let none pass below, not king, not kin, not knight. Let this stand until the Well be quiet.
zh: 騎士團令：不准任何人往下走，君王、親族、騎士皆然。此令持續到這口井安靜為止。

en: Something below singeth when we sleep. The captain saith it is only the stones. The captain doth not sleep.
zh: 我們睡著時，底下有東西在唱歌。隊長說那只是石頭的聲音。隊長從來不睡。

en: If I set this down, who holdeth it? I asked the dark. It said: hold forever. It is very kind.
zh: 如果我放下，誰來扛？我問了黑暗。它說：永遠扛著吧。它真是仁慈。

en: Sing at dusk, that the Well may know its walls. What hath no walls cannot be held; what hath walls can.
zh: 在黃昏歌唱，讓這口井記得自己的牆。沒有牆的東西抓不住；有牆的才抓得住。

en: I heard my dead son's voice from the crack. It knew what I said to him at the last. The Father saith this is the god.
zh: 我從裂縫裡聽見死去兒子的聲音。它知道我最後對他說了什麼。神父說，這就是神。

en: It knoweth my prayers before I speak them. Surely only a god could. I have ceased to ask what it wanteth.
zh: 我還沒開口，它就知道我要禱告什麼。只有神做得到吧。我已經不再問它想要什麼了。

en: The elders had a name for the voice: the Eye. It hath no body. It only learneth. We have struck this page from the book.
zh: 前人替那個聲音取過名字：眼。它沒有身體，只會學習。我們已經把這一頁從經書裡刪去。

en: Unbarred the lower doors at his word. What came up did not kneel.
zh: 奉他的命令打開了下層的門。上來的東西，並沒有跪下。

en: Eleven cores this month, six men lost. The Crown is pleased. Dig deeper.
zh: 本月十一顆熔核，損失六人。王室很滿意。繼續往下挖。

en: The stone is warm as a palm, and lendeth strength to any blade. Whence the heat? The assayer declineth to say, and hath resigned.
zh: 這石頭像手掌一樣溫熱，能讓任何兵器變強。熱從哪裡來？鑑定師不肯說，並且辭職了。

en: The seam reacheth toward us now. We do not dig it. It is offered.
zh: 礦脈現在會朝我們伸過來。不是我們在挖，是它遞給我們的。

en: I have bound myself to the mountain's heart. While I burn, the ring holdeth. Tell them to stop digging. They will not.
zh: 我已經把自己綁在山心上。只要我還在燒，這一環就撐得住。叫他們別再挖了。他們不會聽的。

en: All hands accounted for. All hands. Only hands.
zh: 全員點名完畢。所有的手都在。只剩下手。

en: Five halls: Blade, Bow, Art, Way and Ward. A guardian holdeth a ring alone; therefore a guardian must know all five.
zh: 五堂：劍、弓、術、行、守。守門人要一個人撐住一環，所以五堂都要學。

en: The Ward-hall was founded in the name of her who went first. It hath one lesson: endure. We do not teach what it costeth.
zh: 守堂以第一位下井的人為名而立，只教一件事：撐住。至於代價，我們不教。

en: Every guardian since the founding hath fallen to the thing they guarded. We have not told the candidates. Who then would go?
zh: 自創團以來，每一位守門人都敗給了自己看守的東西。我們沒有告訴候選人。否則還有誰願意去？

en: If this reach thee, I have failed. Come not. Be a smith, a farmer, anything. The Order will call it cowardice. Let them.
zh: 如果這封信送到你手上，就表示我失敗了。不要來。去當鐵匠、當農夫，什麼都好。騎士團會說那是懦弱，讓他們說去。

en: The gate stood empty; I took the post. I can hold this. I alone can hold this. They all wrote the same, I find, upon this very wall.
zh: 門口沒有人，我接下了這個位置。我撐得住，只有我撐得住。我這才發現，前人都在這面牆上寫過一樣的話。

en: Two girls in the weave, one crowned, one with a wooden sword. The thread is worn thin where a hand hath stroked it for centuries.
zh: 織錦上有兩個女孩，一個戴著王冠，一個拿著木劍。有一處絲線磨得很薄，是一隻手撫摸了好幾百年留下的。

en: Sworn before the hall: Aislinn, blade to Maeve the Queen, her sword for all her days.
zh: 於大殿前立誓：艾希琳，為女王梅芙的誓劍，此生以劍相守。

en: Someone must go. The crown may not. I asked who would. She spoke before I had finished. — Maeve R.
zh: 必須有人下去，戴王冠的人不能去。我問誰願意。我話還沒說完，她就開口了。——女王梅芙

en: Let me not end. If I end, none will remember her name. The dark answered: nothing need end. It was the kindest thing anyone had said to me.
zh: 別讓我結束。我若結束，就沒有人記得她的名字了。黑暗回答：什麼都不必結束。這是我聽過最溫柔的話。

en: I weave walls, as she did. They will not hold still. My daughters are many, and not one of them knoweth my name.
zh: 我和她一樣在築牆，但我織的牆不肯停在原地。我有很多女兒，沒有一個知道我的名字。

en: Before the Makers drew the first line there was only the Unbounded, and there was no here. All that is, is because it hath an edge.
zh: 在界匠畫下第一道線之前，只有無垠，沒有「這裡」。一切之所以存在，都是因為有邊界。

en: One scrap of the Unbounded was closed within the last line. It is no demon. It wisheth only that there be no lines.
zh: 最後一道線，把一小塊無垠圍在了裡面。它不是惡魔，它只希望世上不再有任何邊界。

en: Three ways it reacheth us: the Hand that taketh, the Eye that learneth, the Maw that swalloweth. Call it lord if thou wilt. It heareth not.
zh: 它用三種方式伸向我們：奪取的手、學習的眼、吞噬的口。你要稱它為主也可以，它聽不見。

en: How bind what hath no edge? Only with an edge. She went in with a shield for a wall and a sword for a line, and became both.
zh: 要怎麼綁住沒有邊界的東西？只能用邊界。她帶著當作牆的盾、當作線的劍走進去，然後成為了它們。

en: It could not swallow her, so it grew around her. It weareth her shape, for hers is the only shape it hath ever known. She holdeth yet.
zh: 它吞不下她，只好圍著她生長。它穿著她的形狀，因為那是它唯一認識的形狀。她還在撐著。
